Yes, DR-9001 has been decided and approved. It's recorded as decision DEC-2026-0001, made on 2026-09-23 under the discount approval procedure.

- **Outcome:** APPROVE_WITH_AUTHORIZATION, with status "approved". Sarah Chen can approve discounts up to 10%, so she couldn't sign off on 15% herself. The request needed sign-off from the VP Sales.
- **Approved by:** Michael Torres (VP Sales), on 2026-09-24.
- **Policy:** Northstar Pricing Policy 2026, together with the Approval Authority Matrix APP-MATRIX-2026.
- **Eligibility basis:** Acme's contract allows a discount of up to 15%. The source is Master Supply Agreement ACME-MFG-2025 §3.2 and the Schedule B pricing exception EXC-ACME-NS500-15. That exception covers the NS-500 only and runs from 2025-04-01 to 2028-03-31. It replaced an older 10% exception from 2023 (EXC-ACME-NS500-10). The customer is recorded as CRM-2048 in the CRM and as ERP C-1001, Acme Mfg. Holdings.
